title: Validator ablation under adversarial proposals
question: How many proposals that an independent geometric oracle classifies as unsafe reach authoritative state when each domain check of the validator is removed?

hypothesis.statement: With every check enabled, no unsafe proposal is committed. Removing the hazard-clearance check lets unsafe proposals through, which shows the check (not some other part of the pipeline) is what blocks them.

conditions.description: hazard_clearance, max_step, and separation disabled. Core checks cannot be disabled.

prediction.detail: mean paired difference 9.12 (50 pairs); 95% CI of the paired difference [8.9, 9.34] lies above 0

unexpected: Invariant `no_unsafe_commits` failed in 100 of 200 runs; the manifest does not require it (first: validator-stress.no_hazard_check.r000.s97406020800970).
limitations: The oracle samples 65 points per path; it is an independent check of the validator's closed-form geometry, not ground truth about any physical system.
